15 steps to sell your property in 60–90 days

Questions? Message us on WhatsApp.

Message on WhatsApp

  1. Set a realistic price

    Compare with recent sales of similar properties in your area, not with listing prices. A price more than 10% above the market slows down viewings.

  2. Gather the documents before you list

    Title at the Public Registry, property tax and water clearance, up-to-date maintenance fees if it is a condo (PH), floor plans. With everything ready, you close faster when an offer comes.

  3. Decide your minimum price and what the sale includes

    Furniture, appliances, handover date. Decide it first, so you do not negotiate from zero with every buyer.

  4. Clean, declutter and fix the small things

    Remove personal items, fix taps and lamps, touch up the paint. A tidy place looks bigger in photos.

  5. Take professional photos in natural light

    20 to 30 horizontal photos, in the daytime with the curtains open. The first photo decides whether people open the listing.

  6. Record a short video

    A 60-second walk-through on your phone, vertical, for Instagram and Facebook.

  7. Write a clear description

    Location, square meters, bedrooms, year, maintenance fee and what is nearby. No empty adjectives like “amazing”.

  8. Think about who buys

    Beach, view, security, internet, rental potential. If the buyer is a foreigner, explain the process: payment, lawyer and documents.

  9. List where the buyers are

    Facebook and Instagram to reach people who are not searching yet, and Google for people who already search “house for sale” in your area.

  10. Use your own page with one button

    A web page with photos, the price and a clear WhatsApp button. Fewer steps, more messages.

  11. Reply in under 24 hours, ideally in one

    Buyers write to several properties. The one who replies first wins.

  12. Filter before you show

    Ask about budget, timeline and how they will pay. That way you only show the property to people who can buy.

  13. Group the viewings

    Two or three a day, with the property ready, aired and bright. You save time and the interest shows.

  14. Work with Restate Deals instead of agencies

    An agency is paid from the sale and works many properties at once. Here we advertise your property for 45 days, at a fixed price, with results you can see:

    • No commission: with a broker you pay 5% + 7% ITBMS on the commission. Here you pay a fixed price for 45 days of ads and the ads directly to Facebook and Google.
    • You see the numbers: every week we tell you how many people saw your ad and how many messaged you.
    • Guarantee: a set number of people message you on WhatsApp. If we fall short in 45 days, we keep advertising for free.
    • No exclusivity: you can keep your broker.
    • Faster: we advertise for 45 days. With a broker the average is 224 days (ACOBIR MLS, first half of 2026).

  15. Review every two weeks and adjust

    Check how many messages and viewings come in. If there are no viewings in 30 days, change the photos, the text or the price. Do not wait for months.

Questions

FAQ

Do you charge a commission?

No. I'm a marketer, not a broker. You pay for the work every 45 days and the ads directly to Facebook and Google. No percentage of the sale.

Who pays for the ads?

You do, directly to the Meta and Google ad accounts.

What if only a few people message me?

If fewer people than promised message you in 45 days, we keep advertising for free until we get there. No money back: we deliver the number.

How long does it take?

Each round of ads lasts 45 days. We start a week after we get the photos. You can continue with another round.

Do you use Google too?

Yes. Ads on Google for people searching for homes in your area. We decide with you how much goes to Google and how much to Facebook.

What does the WhatsApp assistant do?

It asks every person who messages you what they want, their budget and timing. You see the answers and decide who to answer first. This is not part of the guarantee.

Do I need to give exclusivity?

No. You can keep selling on your own or with a broker.

Ready to apply?

Send me the price and the location. We check if we're a fit and I confirm if there is a spot.
